༄༅/ /mgon dkar yid bzhin nor bu'i mchod bskang dngos grub kun stsol zhes bya ba bzhugs/

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /mgon dkar yid bzhin nor bu'i mchod bskang dngos grub kun stsol zhes bya ba

bzhugs/ oṃ swā sti/ mgon dkar yid bzhin nor bu'i mchod bskang dngos grub kun stsol zhes bya ba/ bla ma rnams pa phyag 'tshal lo/ /mchod rdzas rnams bshams shing*/ sngon 'gro btang*/ bdag mdun gtor 'bul sogs kyi rjes su/ a mṛ ta sa bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las gnas khang bh+ruṃ las rin po che las grub pa'i thar pa chen po'i gzhal yas khang mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbus su/ a las ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i nang du lha dang mi las khyad par 'phags pa'i mchod rdzas sna tshogs/ bskang rdzas sna tshogs/ grub rdzas sna tshogs/ 'dod yon sna tshogs/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi smon lam dang thugs rje las grub pa dang*/ khyad par du yang 'phags pa kun tu bzang po'i rnam par thar pa las byung ba'i mchod pa'i yo byad bsam gyis mi khyab pa yongs su gang ba/ bla ma dang mgon po yid bzhin nor bu sangs rgyas dang byang sems/ 'khor tshogs mkha' 'gro grangs med/ las mdzad gnod sbyin bzhi/ dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad kyi spyan lam du 'byung zhing rgyas par gyur cig /oṃ sarba bid pu ra pu ra su ra su ra ā warta ya a warta ho/ oṃ badz+ra sa spa ra ṇa khaṃ swāhā/ dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis/ /tshur gshegs tshur gshegs bcom ldan 'das/ /bla ma mgon po dbyer med mchog /mgon dkar yid bzhin nor bu ni/ /'khor tshogs mkha' 'gro grangs med dang*/ /sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo dang*/ /gnod spyin bzhi dang bka' nyan rnams/ / mchod pa'i gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /mchod pa'i gnas 'dir gshegs nas kyang*/ /mgon po yid bzhin nor bu tshogs/ /sna tshogs mchod pas mnyes gyur nas/ /'gro kun dpal 'byor rgyas pa dang*/ khyad par bdag cag dpon slob kyis/ /chos 'byor dge legs 'phel ba dang*/ /kun mkhyen sangs rgyas thob bya'i phyir/

'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ / badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ pad+ma kā ma la s+t+waṃ/ kun bzang mchong sprin rgya mtsho las byung ba'i/ / yan lag brgyad ldan rab dkar 'o ma'i mtsho/ /dwangs shing dri med rab dkar zhabs bsil dang*/ /ut+pal pad+ma u tam wā ra'i tshogs/ /sbyar dang lhan skyes dri zhim sbos kyi tshogs/ /nyi zla nor bu snang byed 'od gsal dang*/ /kur gum ga bur la sogs dri bzang tshogs/ /sman rnams 'bras dang sman mchog ro brgya'i zas/ /rab snyan sgra dbyangs mchod sprin dpag med kyis/ /bla ma mgon po dbyer med thugs dam bskang*/ /mgon dkar yid bzhin nor bu'i thugs dam bskang/ /mkha' 'gro grangs med 'bum gyi= /las mdzad gnod spyin bzhi'i= / 'khor tshogs dam can rgyal po'i= /'khor dang bcas pa mchod pas dgyes gyur nas/ bdag cag 'khor bcas chos 'byor gong 'phel zhing*/ /byang chub bar gyi srung ma khyod kyis mdzod/ /bkra shis rin chen bdun dang 'dod yon lnga/ /bkra shis rdzas brgyad bkra shis rtags brgyad dang*/ /bkra shis lha mo brgyad kyis mchod sprin sogs/ /bkra shis phun tshogs mchod rdzas bkra shis kyis/ /bla ma mgon po= /mgon dkar= /mkha' 'gro= /las mdzad= /'khor tshogs= / 'khor dang bcas= /bdag cag= /byang chub= /rab dkar mtshan ldan kun bzang ka pa lar/ /rab dkar ye shes bdud rtsi rgya mtsho 'khyil/ /rab dkar phyag rgya yid kyis byin rlabs pa'i= /rab dkar ye shes bdud rtsi rgya mtsho 'dis/ /bla ma mgon po= /mgon dkar= /mkha' 'gro= /las mdzad= /'khor tshogs= /'khor dang bcas= /bdag cag= /byang chub= /rab mdzes lang tshos dregs pa'i smin legs ma/ /dkyus rings zur mig 'dod pa'i mda' 'phen zhing*/ /bde chen chags pas myos pa'i rnam 'gyur mkhas/ /rab mdzes gsang yum lha mo 'bum phrag gis/ /bla ma mgon po= /mgon dkar= /mkha' 'gro= / las mdzad= /'khor tshogs= /'khor dang bcas= /bdag cag= /byang chub= /

rnam dag sangs rgyas byang sems 'phags tshogs dang*/ /bdag gzhan sngags sogs ting 'dzin ye shes las/ /grub pas bdag po'i yongs su ma bzung ba'i/ /mchod pa'i sprin phung rab dkar thams cad kyis/ /bla ma mgon po= / mgon dkar= /mkha' 'gro= /las mdzad= /'khor tshogs= /'khor dang bcas= /bdag cag= /byang chub bar gyis= /nas 'bras gro sran til sogs 'bras bu'i tshogs/ /shing tog ka ra bu ram rgun 'brum dang*/ /sha mar thud sogs zas mchog stong phrag dang*/ /ja chang 'o ma bdud rtsi sbrang gi bcud/ /sbyar dang rang byung bdud rtsi rgya mtsho'i tshogs/ /gser dngul mu tig rin chen bā+ai ḍūr+ya/ /mar gad byu ru g.yu dang spol shel dang*/ /sra brtan mdzes pas go mtshon sna tshogs dang*/ /snam bu dar zab srab 'jam lha rdzas kyis/ /bla ma mgon po= / mgon dkar= /mkha' 'gro= /las mdzad= /'khor tshogs= /'khor dang bcas= /bdag cag= /byang chub= /cang shes rta dang g.yang chags lug gi khyu/ / 'dod 'jo'i ba dang khyu mchog g.yang gi tshogs/ /seṅge stag dom dred sogs rkang bzhi dang*/ /gter bum dpag bsam shing dang g.yas 'khyil dung*/ /rin chen ri bo yid 'ong khang bzang dang*/ /gzugs mdzes dbyangs snyan dri zhim ro mchog gos/ /bsam kun rdzogs byed dgos 'dod nor bu yis/ /bla ma mgon po= / mgon dkar= /mkha' 'gro= las mdzad= /'khor tshogs= /'khor dang bcas= /bdag cag= /byang chub= /ri rgyal gling bzhi nyi zla gling phran bcas/ / stong gsum bgrang yas gzhi dang me tog gis/ /rgyan pa'i gangs can mtsho'i zhing khams kun/ /rang bzhin gyis grub mchod rdzas rgya mtsho dang*/ /dngos bshams yid sprul chod sprin mtha' yas pas/ /bla ma mgon po= /mgon dkar= /mkha' 'gro= /las mdzad= /'khor tshogs= /'khor dang bcas= /bdag cag= /byang chub bar gyi bsrung ma khyod kyis mdzod/ / de nas bstod pa ni/ lhun sdug kā+ai la sha'i ri bo ltar/ /'od zer bye bas 'khyud pa'i dpal 'phreng can/

/dbang sdud mkha' 'gro stong gi bdag po ni/ /myur mdzad spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /'dzum bag brjid pas zhal ras yid tsam khro/ /'dod dgu char 'bebs dbang gi rgyal po khyod/ /chos nyid thig le sgong nga 'dod pa'i sems/ /dngos su gyur pa'i sku la= /dngul chus mdangs gsal hūṃ yig las 'khrungs pa/ /skye 'gro re skong dbul ba'i sdug bsngal sel/ /dbu skra gyen brjes sbyi bo mi bskyod rgyal/ /rgyas gdab chen po'i dbang bskur khyod la bstod/ kha ba ri la 'char kha gsar ba ltar/ khyod zhal sm-in mtshams sin+dhur thig le 'dzes/ /rin chen gdu'u 'khrol ba'i khyag drug pa/ /bla med pha rol phyin pa'i ngo bor bstod/ /gri gug yid bzhin nor bu ḍā ma ru/ /nor bus gtams pa'i thod pa bum par bcas/ /rtse gsum dngos grub 'gugs pas lcags kyu bsnams/ /phyag drug mgon po khyod la gus pas bstod/ /lhab lhub dar dang stag lbags na bza' can/ /'od 'bar rin chen brgyan kyis sil khrol dang*/ /nor bus chun 'phyang du mas rab brjid pa'i/ / gzi byin lhang nge 'bar la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /'dod pa'i longs spyod char chen 'beb byed pa/ /bi na ya ka'i steng na rol pas bzhugs/ /rab sngon tsan+dan ljon pa'i tshal na dgyes/ /gnas gsum 'kha' 'gro'i bdag po khyod la bstod/ / thugs kar dbang gi lha mo lang tsho ma/ /'char kha'i 'od ris gsal ba klog 'phran ltar/ /mdzes shing dngos grub g.yo ba'i lcags kyu 'dzin/ /srid gsum dbang du sdud la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /de ltar bstod cing gsol ba 'debs pa dang*/ /snying nas lha mchog khyod la gdung ba yis/ /mchod gtor 'bul gyis bdag la mchog bstsal nas*/ /dpal dang 'dod pa'i don kun grub par mdzod/ /thugs rje'i spṛn kyis dpal 'byor rgya mtsho rnams/ /gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas par shog / ces pa mgon dkar yid bzhin nor bu'i bstod bskang 'di yang*/

rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas rang lo bcu dgu pa la'o// // maṅga laṃ// bkra shis// mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/tā ra nā tha'i gsung thor bu'i skor/ - PAGE 116 -- PAGE 115 -- PAGE 112 -
